$comment: Design choice, not fact: every camera value (center, zoom, pitch, bearing, zoomShift) and every layer was picked to prove the sentence the stop sits by (map tour batch 4, 22 Oct 2026). Facts: text is a sentence of the guide, or a tightened form of one; cite is from the cite list of the guide chapter or fly it comes from. Points are the IGN place names of data/story/names-alicante.geojson or the guide's own fly point.

facts.label: Villena
facts.text: The plain around the Vinalopó river at Villena reaches into Albacete, up to the Sierra de la Oliva.

facts.label: Cabo de la Nao
facts.text: In La Marina Alta, air from the Cabo de la Nao runs into high, dense mountains.

facts.label: Serra de la Carrasqueta
facts.text: The Sierras de Carrasqueta and Maigmó turn the sea breezes inland.

facts.label: Sierra del Carche
facts.text: Near Abanilla and Jumilla the land forms one zone of limy, very dry soil on the north side of the Sierra del Carche.
